full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media urban image shows pedestrians walking along a broad city walkway beneath translucent layers of yellow, rust and gray texture. Three dark figures seen from behind occupy the near center, moving toward a hazy group farther down the path. A more isolated passerby approaches along the left edge, softened by blur. The walkway recedes between a dark leafy canopy at upper left and a pale linear riverside or street edge at right. Faint vehicles, railings and a large distant stone structure appear behind the figures, though their outlines are partly lost under the added marks. A bold golden-yellow field washes across the upper-right half, breaking into irregular rectangles and scraped verticals. Near the lower right, smaller rust-red blocks and black scratches interrupt the gray pavement. Transparent layers let fragments of the photographic city show through, while other passages feel rubbed out or overprinted. The pedestrians remain legible mainly as dark silhouettes against warm light, their individual features deliberately indistinct. Illumination appears diffuse in the underlying photograph, but the overlaid yellow acts like a second glowing source, brightening the middle and right while cool gray shadow persists at left. Grain, weathering, smudged edges and repeated linear marks make the surface feel like a worn print. No reliable text can be read. The overall composition pulls the eye into urban depth while broad warm abstract planes flatten and energize the scene.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒介都市画面呈现行人走在宽阔城市步道上，透明的黄、锈与灰色肌理一层层覆在其上。三道从背后看的深色人影占据近处中央，朝步道远处一群朦胧人影走去。更孤立的一名行人在左边迎面走来，边缘被模糊柔化。道路在左上深色叶冠与右侧浅色线性河岸或街缘之间退远。淡淡车辆、栏杆与远处大型石质结构位于人影后，轮廓部分被附加痕迹遮住。大胆金黄色域洗过右上半部，裂成不规则矩形与刮擦竖线。右下附近，较小锈红色块与黑色划痕打断灰色路面。透明层让摄影都市片段透出，其他地方则像被擦掉或重复套印。行人主要作为暖光前的深色剪影可读，个体五官刻意模糊。底层照片的光似乎漫射，但覆盖的黄色像第二道发光源，照亮中右部，左侧仍留冷灰阴影。颗粒、磨损、模糊边缘和重复线痕让表面像一张旧印刷品。无法读出可靠文字。整体构图把视线拉入都市纵深，宽阔暖色抽象色面却同时压平并激活场景。
style_prompt_en: A layered photo-painting treatment lets grayscale photographic structure show through translucent saffron, rust and charcoal overprints. Broad warm color fields interrupt finer perspective detail, while scraped rectangles, vertical streaks and dark smudges create a weathered surface. Focal shapes remain silhouette-like rather than finely modeled; their edges soften or disappear where layers overlap. Light is partly photographic and partly graphic, with glowing yellow areas sitting against cool gray shadows without a single consistent beam. Fine grain and distressed marks unify the depth cues with the flat collage planes. The composition alternates receding lines and blunt color blocks, producing a restless, metropolitan rhythm and a sense of remembered rather than literal space.
style_prompt_zh: 层叠摄影绘画处理让灰阶摄影结构从透明藏红黄、锈色与炭黑套印层下显露。宽阔暖色色域打断更细的透视细节，刮擦矩形、竖向条痕 和深色擦痕形成磨旧表面。焦点形状保持剪影感，而非细致塑形；层次重叠处边缘柔化或消失。光部分来自摄影、部分来自图形效果，发亮黄色区与冷灰阴影相对，却没有单一一致的束光。细颗粒与做旧痕迹把纵深线索同平面拼贴色块统一。构图在退远线条与钝重色块之间交替，形成躁动的都市节奏和记忆中而非字面上的空间感。
theme_en: Pedestrians on a city walkway layered with golden and rust abstract textures
theme_zh: 城市步道上的行人被金黄与锈色抽象肌理层层覆盖
